question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"bars."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"bars"** refers to long, narrow pieces of metal or wood that are used as a barrier or for support. (धातु या लकड़ी के लंबे, संकीर्ण टुकड़े जिनका उपयोग बाधा के रूप में या समर्थन के लिए किया जाता है) • **Example**: *The gorilla rattled the bars__ of its cage.* • In the context of the question, **bars** would be the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • So, the correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage: He __opened__ his eyes. Moonlight was shining __through__ the bars on the window. And __someone__ was goggling through the __bars__ at him: a freckle-faced, red-haired, long-nosed someone. Ron Weasley was outside Harry's ______ (5) _______.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "verticals,"** refers to something oriented in a vertical position, but it is not specific enough for the given context. (ऊर्ध्वाधर स्थिति में उन्मुख कुछ) • **Option 3, "grills,"** refers to a cooking apparatus or a decorative screen with parallel bars, but it is not relevant to the given context. (खाना पकाने का एक उपकरण या समानांतर पट्टियों वाली एक सजावटी स्क्रीन) • **Option 4, "horizontals,"** refers to something oriented in a horizontal position, but it is not specific enough for the given context. (क्षैतिज स्थिति में उन्मुख कुछ) 1cf:Tfc5, The correct answer is **"window."**
